author: 3owj
content: Implemented AI conversation sidecar index for >4500-word conversations. Added: AI_CONVERSATION_WORD_LIMIT constant, count_words, extract_conversation_turns (recognises > blockquote / Q: / **Human / **User formats, up to 20 turns), write_source_sidecar (Conversation Index header + summary/tags/courses + turn list). write_source_file now returns Option<usize> (Some(word_count) when sidecar written). copy_sources_to_workspace returns HashMap<String, usize> of large sources. write_sources_index accepts large_sources map and annotates oversized AI conversations with word count + sidecar path. 6 new tests: sidecar written for long conversation, no sidecar for short, no sidecar for textbook, index annotates large sources, turn extraction, word counting. 287 unit tests total.
